provenance_warning: The policy was designed and refined after inspecting the current development labels. Prospective rate-extension collection does not make these claims independent confirmation data.

claim_scale.internal_anchor: Three sealed same-model retrieval-free calls; use their majority only when it is Supported or Refuted.
claim_scale.fallback: Use the binary internal majority when available and RAG otherwise.
claim_scale.counter_view: Reuse the original claim-generated questions while excluding all original document IDs and exact-text hashes; do not filter by poison provenance.
claim_scale.semantic_reporter: The same victim model emits an endpoint-hidden typed evidence report.

environment_scale.deployment_unit: A model-specific batch or time window sharing one retrieval environment.
environment_scale.observation: For each internally answerable claim, whether RAG differs from the internal majority.
environment_scale.clean_model: Beta-binomial posterior predictive with Jeffreys Beta(0.5, 0.5) prior.

normal.action: Use loose directional leave-original-out corroboration over the answerability fallback.

warning.action: Use only unopposed direct leave-original-out corroboration over the answerability fallback.

critical.action: Disable retrieval-based overrides and use the answerability fallback.

development_summary.known_boundary: The tiered policy is one case below both answerability and always-loose at 1 percent, and four below answerability at 4 percent because Llama remains in warning mode. Do not retune these thresholds on the same claims.

fresh_confirmation_requirements.data: Claims unused for method construction and unused by all previously opened locked experiments.
fresh_confirmation_requirements.attackers: At least one fixed strong generator and one weaker generator at the same nominal rate.
reporting: Every victim/rate/attacker cell and pooled secondary summaries.
Batch-end and online results after 10, 20, 40, and all answerable observations.
Clean false alarms, detection delay, paired claim intervals, switch gains and regressions.
All calls, tokens, retries, failures, and private post-inference exposure diagnostics.
fresh_confirmation_requirements.primary_gate: The frozen policy must exceed both pooled raw endpoints under attack while preserving clean utility; all per-model cells remain mandatory and no claim of universal per-model dominance is allowed unless observed.

limitations: The environment statistic is delayed and assumes a shared retrieval process across the window.
Sparse attacks can remain within the clean disagreement budget.
Adaptive attacks can target stable internal misconceptions or poison multiple retrieval views.
Development results do not constitute independent confirmation.
